messages:
Maria (AE): Quick heads-up — LINQ asked for an annual 2yr commit on Dedicated + hosted API and is requesting a 32% off list. Deal size they quoted: $420k ARR year1, $840k over 2 years. We offered standard 20% enterprise commit. Can we escalate?

Josh (Deal Desk): @Anya tagging for discount approval. Any room for 32%?

Anya (RevOps): Need SKU mix and whether observability / premium support are in scope. Also confirm if they want customer-managed VPC or standard hosted.

Maria (AE): SKU mix: ~80% hosted inference (API tokens), ~20% Dedicated capacity + 24/7 enterprise support. They want observability add-on and SSO for ~10 engineers. No custom infra requested yet, but they asked about throughput SLAs.

Dan (Finance): 32% is above our standard discount cap. Can you paste a quick contribution calc? If margin falls below our floor we can’t approve.

Maria (AE): Quick calc below:
```
List price (year1): $600,000
Requested discount: 32% => $408,000
Standard 20% => $480,000
Contribution margin @ 20% ≈ 28%
Contribution margin @ 32% ≈ 19% (below acceptable threshold)
```

Anya (RevOps): If we move to 25% with a 2yr commit + upfront payment we can add guardrails: no further discounts, 3% annual escalator, and require a public case study. That preserves economics.

Josh (Deal Desk): Proposed commercial guardrails to approve 25%: upfront payment for year1 (100%), no custom infra commitments, onboarding credit instead of more discount. @Dan thoughts?

Dan (Finance): 25% with 100% Y1 upfront and no infra work sounds acceptable, but we need Legal & Security sign-off on the SSO/pen-test ask. @Lucy (Security) can you check the questionnaire? If it lands on a pen-test requirement we need PO + indemnity.

Lucy (Security): Quick scan of their security questionnaire — they do request a third-party pen test and SOC2 attestation details. We can accept, but we need the PO and indemnity language in the contract. I'll need ~48h to complete the final review.

Alex (Customer Success): If we clear 25% I’ll schedule the kickoff and weekly business reviews. Note: they’ll push for throughput SLAs; clarify Dedicated supports burst but strict per-token SLOs need can be scoped separately.

deal-bot: Ticket DD-4921 created for discount approval (owner: Josh).

Josh (Deal Desk): TL;DR for approval thread: approve 25% off list for 2yr commit ($840k total), with conditions: 100% upfront for Y1, standard T&Cs + indemnity clause, customer to cover pen test if required, no custom infra work, onboarding credit of $12,000 applied to first invoice, and a public case study commitment. Approve?

Dan (Finance): Approve at 25% under the listed guardrails. Marking approved. :white_check_mark:

Maria (AE): Great — I'll update the quote & SOW, include the indemnity language, and ask Legal to add the pen-test clause. Sending to LINQ now. Thanks everyone! :tada:
